title: Software Engineer
summary: Build and maintain web applications that people use for daily business work. You'll take features from a written brief through implementation, testing and release.
responsibilities: Build web features across the interface, API and database.
Write tests for changes to workflows such as approvals, permissions and reporting.
Review pull requests and investigate bugs reported by customers.
requirements: Experience delivering and maintaining features in a production web application.
Working knowledge of relational databases, HTTP API design, Git, and automated testing.
Ability to take a scoped feature through implementation and release, review code, and explain technical trade-offs.
niceToHave: Experience with Laravel, React or business software.
